---
title: "Author-requested unresolved-comment status replies"
format: html
---

Replies only; never resolve comments or change document content. Exact duplicate
replies are skipped. Each write uses the designated-assistant identity gate.

```{python}
import json,sys,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
from manuscript_identity import assistant_access_token,verified_editor,guarded_urlopen
root=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment')
message_path=Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else root/'notes/comment-status-replies-2026-09-22.json'
receipt_path=Path(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else root/'notes/comment-status-reply-receipt-2026-09-22.json'
messages=json.loads(message_path.read_text())
token=assistant_access_token(); editor=verified_editor(token)
headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'}
base='https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/1tl6VL6Z1bYcTDuG67CHY4mOdkWuEIvzWOhBMqKneQbQ/comments/'
receipt=[]
for cid,content in messages.items():
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+cid+'?fields=*',headers=headers)
    with guarded_urlopen(req) as r: current=json.load(r)
    if current.get('deleted') or current.get('resolved'):
        receipt.append(dict(comment=cid,status='skipped_closed'));continue
    if any(r.get('content')==content and not r.get('deleted') for r in current.get('replies',[])):
        receipt.append(dict(comment=cid,status='already_present'));continue
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+cid+'/replies?fields=*',headers=headers,
        data=json.dumps({'content':content}).encode(),method='POST')
    with guarded_urlopen(req) as r: posted=json.load(r)
    assert posted['content']==content
    with guarded_urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+cid+'/replies/'+posted['id']+'?fields=*',headers=headers)) as r: checked=json.load(r)
    assert checked['content']==content and not checked.get('deleted')
    receipt.append(dict(comment=cid,reply=posted['id'],status='posted_and_readback_verified',author=checked.get('author',{}).get('displayName')))
    print(cid,receipt[-1]['status'],flush=True)
receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(dict(editor=editor,replies=receipt,comments_resolved=0,document_content_changed=False),indent=2))
print('Verified',len(receipt),'thread statuses; no comments resolved.')
```
